## Summary

Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Verification

List the commands and scenarios used to verify the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request targets `main` and contains a focused change.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior.
- [ ] Public API, diagnostics, generated output, and package-layout effects were reviewed.
- [ ] Trimming and Native AOT effects were reviewed where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation was updated for user-visible changes.
- [ ] Dependency and SDK changes include reviewed lock-file updates.
